name: Beezil's Wreck
summary: East of Tabetha's Farm, Beezil's Wreck draws scavengers to its broken zeppelin and scattered cargo.

sections.title: A Calamitous Landing
sections.body: East of Tabetha's Farm, the goblin zeppelin lies split apart in the muck. It carried cargo south across Kalimdor before plunging into the swamp. Captain Beezil is gone from the marsh. Crates and ticking machinery lie among the reeds, rotting in the brine.

sections.title: Salvage in the Muck
sections.body: Beasts prowl around the crash site, but scavengers still brave them for the cargo that survived. The zeppelin carried volatile goods, including Seaforium boosters and heavy crates. They risk their lives to salvage what remains before marsh water corrodes it.

faq.answer: Beezil's Wreck lies deep in Dustwallow Marsh, east of Tabetha's Farm, where a goblin zeppelin crashed. It went down while carrying cargo south across Kalimdor.
Beezil is nowhere around the crash site. Searchers do not know whether he escaped into the wilderness or left the marsh.

faq.q: What valuable cargo was the zeppelin carrying?
faq.answer: The zeppelin carried trade goods and volatile goblin engineering components, including Seaforium boosters. Scavengers seek what survived the crash.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can find volatile mechanical parts in the wreck, especially Seaforium boosters any tinkerer would covet.
As a gnome, you see the smoking goblin wreck as a grim reminder of the dangers of non-gnomish aerial design.
